title: Lang-Vojta conjecture over function fields for very general log projective spaces
summary: We consider a bound of degrees of curves by their genera in the log pair $(\mathbb{P}^{n}\times C, D)$, where $C$ is a smooth complex projective curve and $D$ is a very general smooth divisor on $\mathbb{P}^{n}\times C$. Our study is motivated by a function field analogue of the Lang-Vojta conjecture.
